# Local Development Environment Configuration # Activated with: spring.profiles.active=local or --spring.profiles.active=local
spring: datasource: url: jdbc:h2:mem:gymdb;DB_CLOSE_DELAY=-1;DB_CLOSE_ON_EXIT=FALSE username: sa password: driver-class-name: org.h2.Driver
jpa: database-platform: org.hibernate.dialect.H2Dialect hibernate: ddl-auto: create-drop show-sql: true
h2: console: enabled: true path: /h2-console
logging: level: root: INFO epam.arsen.burko.gym: DEBUG org.springframework.web: DEBUG org.springframework.security: DEBUG org.hibernate: DEBUG org.hibernate.orm.jdbc.bind: TRACE pattern: console: "%d{HH:mm:ss.SSS} [%thread] %-5level %logger{36} - %msg%n"
jackson: serialization: indent_output: true
app: environment: local debug-mode: true log-requests: true
management: endpoints: web: exposure: include: health,metrics,prometheus,info,env,configprops,loggers endpoint: health: show-details: always show-components: always endpoints: web: base-path: /actuator
server: port: 8080 compression: enabled: false
logging: level: root: INFO epam.arsen.burko.gym: DEBUG
